title: Aligning local Koszul isomorphisms
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion, V an open, n a natural number and assume Koszul-regular affine generators near V. Write B=i_*O_Z, G=H^n(RHom_Y(B[0],B[0])), T=(i*G)|V and F=dual(exteriorSheaf(i*ker(i),n))|V. For every family W_z containing z and isomorphisms e_z:F.over W_z ≅ T.over W_z there are automorphisms a_z of F.over W_z such that a_z.hom followed by e_z.hom agree on every smaller common open.

proof.text: Produce a chosen cover with compatible local Koszul comparisons. Its neighborhoods contain their indexing points, hence their supremum is top.

Glue the local homs with glue_sheaves_of_modules. Their inverse components agree because inverses of equal isomorphism components are equal. Glue the inverses by the same theorem. The local hom/inverse identities give global identities by the gluing theorem equality criterion, yielding a global comparison isomorphism. This is implemented by the proved private helper iso_of_compatible_cover.

Restrict the global isomorphism c to each arbitrary supplied W_z. Define a_z=(c restricted to W_z) followed by e_z inverse. The inverse identity gives a_z.hom followed by e_z.hom equal to c.hom.over W_z; on a common smaller open both components are definitionally c.hom at that open.

theorem koszulRegularImmersion_self_ext_conormal_local_alignment
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (V : Z.Opens) (n : ℕ)
    (hregular : ∀ z : Z, z ∈ V → ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf
    let G := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (n : ℤ)).obj
        (H.obj (op (S.obj B), S.obj B))
    let T := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj G)
    let F := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
      (Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n))
    ∀ (W : V.toScheme → V.toScheme.Opens)
      (e : ∀ z : V.toScheme, F.over (W z) ≅ T.over (W z)),
      (∀ z : V.toScheme, z ∈ W z) →
      ∃ a : ∀ z : V.toScheme, F.over (W z) ≅ F.over (W z),
        ∀ (x y : V.toScheme) (U : V.toScheme.Opens)
          (hx : U ≤ W x) (hy : U ≤ W y),
          ((a x).hom ≫ (e x).hom).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hx))) =
            ((a y).hom ≫ (e y).hom).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hy)))
